design_system_name: 1976 Analog Retro Editorial & Event Landing Page
aesthetic_direction: Mid-to-late 1970s tactile print, warm analog interiors, groovy swash typography, die-cut sticker badges, and balanced geometric ribbon framing

primary_heading.name: Vintage Tape Charcoal
primary_heading.usage: Main uppercase section headers (e.g., ABOUT), high-contrast UI labels, and cassette hardware framing

display_accent_heading.name: Deep Burnt Sienna
display_accent_heading.usage: Hero swash-serif display typography and editorial pull-quotes

body_copy.name: Deep Espresso Brown
body_copy.usage: Long-form readable paragraphs, card descriptions, and footer links

navigation_and_meta.name: Muted Charcoal Ink
navigation_and_meta.usage: Top navigation bar links, secondary metadata, and micro-labels

inverse_and_badge_text.name: Warm Cream Ink
inverse_and_badge_text.usage: Text inside dark chocolate badges, coral CTA buttons (#FFFFFF), and extruded script fills

botanical_olive.name: Avocado Green
botanical_olive.usage: Secondary feature card headers, organic tags, and vertical stripe accents

vintage_cyan.name: Weathered Vintage Teal
vintage_cyan.usage: Split-panel feature cards, secondary badges, and subtle stripe borders

warm_pastel_blush.name: Dusty Pastel Rose
warm_pastel_blush.usage: Alternating full-width testimonial or highlight band background

soft_sun_glow.name: Muted Peach Blush
soft_sun_glow.usage: Outer rings of the concentric semi-circular sun arch behind hero display text

neutral_ray_tone.name: Muted Slate Gray
neutral_ray_tone.usage: Low-opacity alternating rays in the background sunburst watermark

primary_page_canvas.name: Soft Linen Off-White
primary_page_canvas.usage: Primary viewport background with subtle halftone/linen weave texture

secondary_section_surface.name: Warm Textured Parchment
secondary_section_surface.usage: Card interiors, cassette paper label (#EDE9DA), and alternating content bands

alabaster_hero_tint.name: Warm Alabaster
alabaster_hero_tint.usage: Soft radial glow zone framing the central hero typography

sunburst_cream_ray.name: Sun-Baked Cream
sunburst_cream_ray.usage: Alternating light rays in the subtle hero radial sunburst backdrop

primary_cta_and_ribbon_red.name: Vintage Coral Red
primary_cta_and_ribbon_red.usage: Pill-shaped BUY TICKETS CTA buttons, inner U-bend ribbon stripe, and 3D script shadow layer

golden_highlight_and_tape.name: Harvest Gold
golden_highlight_and_tape.usage: Middle U-bend ribbon stripe, sticker script lettering, and textured masking-tape section divider (#D7B14A)

warm_terracotta_stripe.name: Rust Burnt Orange
warm_terracotta_stripe.usage: Diagonal racing stripes, concentric sun inner rings, and warm upholstery-inspired card accents

cool_outer_ribbon_track.name: Retro Cerulean Blue
cool_outer_ribbon_track.usage: Outer border track of the left and right flanking stadium-curve rainbow ribbons

sticker_badge_base_and_die_cut.name: Roasted Chocolate & Sticker White
sticker_badge_base_and_die_cut.usage: Circular overlay sticker badges with thick white die-cut borders overlapping hero corners

hero_display_serif.visual_traits: Thick vertical stems, razor-thin horizontal hairlines, tight negative letter-spacing, and sweeping terminal swashes on ascenders/descenders

hero_groovy_script.classification: Bold Retro Brush & Extruded Ribbon Script
hero_groovy_script.visual_traits: Connected, rounded, heavy-weight cursive letterforms with a cream inner fill (#FBF4EA), dark espresso outline (#3D2214), and stacked multi-color 3D block shadow (#283E58, #E05A47, #F2CA52)

decorative_numerals_and_badges.visual_traits: Tall, rounded-corner 1970s modular numerals whose vertical strokes extend into parallel diagonal stripes

section_headings_and_ui.visual_traits: All-caps, bold weight, generous horizontal letter-spacing (+0.18em), crisp rounded terminals

body_copy.visual_traits: Regular weight (400), medium x-height, relaxed line-height (1.65) for effortless readability over textured off-white paper

hierarchy_scale.body_paragraph: 1rem (16px), line-height 1.65, max-width 62ch, centered in editorial blocks and left-aligned in cards

typography_style.text_treatment_rules: Display headlines use organic swashes or 3D multi-layered drop shadows; UI headings and body text remain completely flat and un-extruded to preserve crisp legibility.

composition_and_overlap_rules.alignment_grid: 12-column centered container (max-width 1200px) with full-bleed edge-anchored graphic wings outside the central 720px hero column

permitted_overlaps: Circular white-bordered chocolate sticker badge (z-20) overlapping the bottom-right corner of the rectangular charcoal cassette illustration (z-10) — permitted due to contrasting shape (circle vs. rectangle), edge treatment (thick #FFFFFF die-cut outline vs. dark #2B2B2B bevel), and color.

High-contrast burnt-sienna swash serif headline (z-10) overlapping the lower baseline of the soft semi-circular sun arch (z-5) — permitted due to sharp serif strokes contrasting against soft gradient concentric arcs.
Horizontal crinkled golden masking-tape strip (z-20) overlapping the seam between the off-white hero canvas and parchment content section — permitted as a tactile physical divider.
prohibited_overlaps: Flanking U-bend rainbow ribbons must NOT touch or overlap the central cassette illustration or sunburst rays.
Diagonal racing stripes and radial sunburst rays must never occupy the same bounding box.

absolute_website_landing_page_design.viewport_dimensions: Responsive desktop-first 1440px reference frame, collapsing gracefully to single-column mobile below 768px
